message: packageManager in package.json (line 4) pins npm@11.19.1, but Node.js 26 in GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/ci.yml, job latest) does not come with Corepack (Node.js 25.0.0 stopped distributing it), and Corepack is what reads that pin: npm there is npm@latest, which line 9 of .github/workflows/ci.yml installs
fix: Make line 9 of .github/workflows/ci.yml install the pinned release (npm install -g npm@11.19.1), or install Corepack in job latest of .github/workflows/ci.yml before it runs npm (a step that runs npm install -g corepack, then corepack enable npm); npm itself does not read packageManager, while it checks devEngines.packageManager itself

message: packageManager in package.json (line 4) pins npm@11.19.1, but Node.js 26 in GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/ci.yml, job before-setup) does not come with Corepack (Node.js 25.0.0 stopped distributing it), and Corepack is what reads that pin: without a separate Corepack install, npm there is whatever npm comes with that Node.js
fix: Install Corepack in job before-setup of .github/workflows/ci.yml before it runs npm (a step that runs npm install -g corepack, then corepack enable npm); npm itself does not read packageManager, while it checks devEngines.packageManager itself

message: packageManager in package.json (line 4) pins npm@11.19.1, but Node.js 26 in Dockerfile does not come with Corepack (Node.js 25.0.0 stopped distributing it), and Corepack is what reads that pin: npm there is npm@11.18.0, which line 2 of Dockerfile installs
fix: Make line 2 of Dockerfile install the pinned release (npm install -g npm@11.19.1), or install Corepack in Dockerfile before npm runs (RUN npm install -g corepack && corepack enable npm); npm itself does not read packageManager, while it checks devEngines.packageManager itself
